criteria.text: `test/atlas-modules-acceptance.test.ts` no longer exists in the repository.

`test/invariants.test.ts` exists and, run alone (`node --test test/invariants.test.ts`), passes, covering: import-graph acyclicity, the DOM-free module list, the `html`-tag-only markup scan (including a `templateLiterals` export), the public-file-served check, and the design-5 no-style/no-inline-script checks — every one of these previously in `atlas-modules-acceptance.test.ts` still has a passing assertion somewhere in the suite.

No test anywhere in the repository asserts that `render.ts`'s source text matches `/\bframe\s*\(/` or `/\baxis\s*\(/`, counts literal `<svg` or `<line class="…-axis"` occurrences in `render.ts`, or extracts a named export's body by string search on `export const ${name} = `. (Grep for `frame\s*\(/` / `<svg\\b/g` / `export const \$\{name\}` inside `test/*.ts` — the pattern must not exist outside `src/ui/marks.ts`/`render.ts` themselves or `marks.test.ts`'s own direct calls to `frame`/`axis`.)
`grep -c "moduleSource(\|readFileSync(.*src/ui" test/*.ts` (or equivalent) returns nonzero only for `test/invariants.test.ts`, `test/bundle-freshness.test.ts` and `test/docs-drift.test.ts`.

No `describe(` or `it(` call anywhere under `test/` opens its label string with `AC` followed by a digit, or with `issue #`. (`grep -rEn "^\s*(describe|it)\(['\"](AC[0-9]|issue #)" test/` returns no matches.)

`render.test.ts`'s existing assertions on ghost-painter `innerHTML` (the `strip-axis`, `ruler-axis` and equivalent class-name checks already present) are untouched and still pass, confirming no visible-output coverage was lost when the implementation pins were deleted.
`CLAUDE.md`'s `test/` bullet states that a test asserts on output or behaviour, and that reading a module's source is permitted only to check a repo-wide invariant named in `test/invariants.test.ts`.
Nothing in `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/factory.md` names `atlas-modules-acceptance.test.ts` any more.
`docs/factory.md`'s description of where a new acceptance criterion goes no longer instructs putting an issue number in a label's title.

`pnpm test` passes, and its total test count changes by exactly the number of assertions deleted in point 3 (the two `frame(`/`axis(`/`<svg` pins plus the per-ghost body scanner) — no other test is added or removed as a side effect of the rename.
